environment: Isolated callback component; injected Clerk/navigation, no real Google OAuth

checks.name: cold SDK load starts callback once after a stable Clerk instance becomes ready
warm SDK load preserves all signup and signin continuation destinations
external return targets, nested callbacks and invalid attempts cannot escape the server completion route
missing event context uses dashboard events without inventing a registration attempt
unloaded SDK gives recovery after 20 seconds with the entire original journey intact
pending or resolved callback without navigation gives recovery without automatic retries or direct event navigation
late SDK readiness still starts its callback after the recovery message appears
a different callback journey remounts its handler with the correct event and attempt
remount with a simulated active session keeps completion owned by Clerk and preserves the attempt
unmount clears the watchdog instead of updating an abandoned callback
